faq_heading: Homes near James Ardiel Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the James Ardiel Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the James Ardiel Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near James Ardiel Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near James Ardiel Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 83 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000, condos $386,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near James Ardiel Elementary?
faq.a: Near James Ardiel Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 27 days to sell and closed at 96.2% of the list price, with 7% over asking, across 83 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to James Ardiel Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Surrey Traditional (0.2 km north-east), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.0 km south) and Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.5 km south-west).

James Ardiel Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13751 112 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions James Ardiel Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the James Ardiel Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names James Ardiel Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of James Ardiel Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 83 homes sold within 1 km of James Ardiel Elementary: 27 houses and 49 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $386,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of James Ardiel Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of James Ardiel Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 3 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is Surrey Traditional, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Khalsa School Old Yale Road, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is K B Woodward Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Surrey Traditional (0.2 km north-east), Forsyth Road Elementary (1.0 km south), Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.5 km south), Ellendale Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Surrey Traditional, 0.2 km north-east of James Ardiel Elementary.
